# CPL Season

> CPL Season provides independent coverage of the Caribbean Premier League,
> with a focus on the 2026 season.

CPL Season publishes schedules, match pages, squads, player profiles, team
guides, venue information, standings, broadcast details, and news. The
canonical site is https://cplseason.com/.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://cplseason.com/): Latest CPL 2026 overview and updates.
- [Schedule](https://cplseason.com/schedule/): Full match schedule, dates, and fixtures.
- [Points table](https://cplseason.com/points-table/): Current team standings.
- [Teams](https://cplseason.com/teams/): CPL 2026 team directory.
- [Squads](https://cplseason.com/squads/): Team rosters for the 2026 season.
- [Players](https://cplseason.com/players/): Player directory and profiles.
- [Venues](https://cplseason.com/venues/): Stadium and venue guides.
- [Watch live](https://cplseason.com/watch-live/): Broadcast and streaming information.
- [News](https://cplseason.com/news/): CPL news and editorial coverage.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://cplseason.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of public URLs.
- [Extended LLM guide](https://cplseason.com/llms-full.txt): Additional site context.
- [Robots policy](https://cplseason.com/robots.txt): Crawler directives.

## Notes

- Prefer canonical HTTPS URLs from the sitemap.
- Match times and standings can change; check the relevant page for the latest published information.
- CPL Season is an independent information site and is not the official Caribbean Premier League website.
